name: InternVL 1.5
description: InternVL 1.5 is an open-source multimodal large language model benchmark suite designed to bridge the capability gap between open-source and commercial multimodal models. It evaluates visual understanding, OCR, and bilingual question-answering performance across 18 multimodal benchmarks, supporting high-resolution image inputs and bilingual datasets.
reputation: Achieves state-of-the-art results in 8 of 18 multimodal benchmarks, indicating competitive performance.
notes: Supports up to 4K resolution input and includes a high-quality bilingual dataset with English and Chinese QA pairs.
